framework: HIPAA Security, Privacy & Breach Notification Rules
version: 45 CFR Part 164 (Security Rule Subpart C in force; Jan-2025 NPRM still proposed)
jurisdiction: US (health / covered entities and business associates)
source_note: Official eCFR text of 45 CFR Part 164 (public domain). Every Security Rule standard and implementation specification, plus the Breach Notification and key Privacy Rule sections, taken from it.
note: Applies only when electronic protected health information (ePHI) is involved.

controls.name: Security standards: general rules
controls.description: Ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of ePHI; flexibility of approach; required vs addressable specifications.

controls.name: Security management process
controls.description: Standard. Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

controls.name: Risk analysis
controls.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of risks to ePHI.

controls.name: Risk management
controls.description: Implement measures to reduce risks to a reasonable and appropriate level.

controls.name: Sanction policy
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate.

controls.name: Information system activity review
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.

controls.name: Assigned security responsibility
controls.description: Standard. Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by this subpart for the covered entity or business associate.

controls.name: Workforce security

controls.name: Authorization and/or supervision
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed.

controls.name: Workforce clearance procedure
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to electronic protected health information is appropriate.

controls.name: Termination procedures
controls.description: Procedures for terminating access to ePHI when employment ends.

controls.name: Information access management
controls.description: Authorize and control access to ePHI (access authorization/establishment/modification).

controls.name: Isolating health care clearinghouse functions
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). If a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, the clearinghouse must implement policies and procedures that protect the electronic protected health information of the clearinghouse

controls.name: Access authorization
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.

controls.name: Access establishment and modification
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement policies and procedures that, based upon the covered entity's or the business associate's access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to a

controls.name: Security awareness and training
controls.description: Train the workforce, including on malicious software and password management.

controls.name: Security reminders
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Periodic security updates.

controls.name: Protection from malicious software
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.

controls.name: Log-in monitoring
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.

controls.name: Password management
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.

controls.name: Security incident procedures
controls.description: Identify, respond to and document security incidents.

controls.name: Response and reporting
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate; an

controls.name: Contingency plan
controls.description: Data backup, disaster recovery and emergency mode operation plans.

controls.name: Data backup plan
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Disaster recovery plan
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to restore any loss of data.

controls.name: Emergency mode operation plan
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of the security of electronic protected health information while operating in emerge

controls.name: Testing and revision procedures
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.

controls.name: Applications and data criticality analysis
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.

controls.name: Evaluation
controls.description: Standard. Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this rule and, subsequently, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of el

controls.name: Business associate contracts
controls.description: Obtain satisfactory assurances that business associates safeguard ePHI.

controls.name: Written contract or other arrangement
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Document the satisfactory assurances required by paragraph (b)(1) or (b)(2) of this section through a written contract or other arrangement with the business associate that meets the applicable requir

controls.name: Facility access controls
controls.description: Standard. Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

controls.name: Contingency operations
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an

controls.name: Facility security plan
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.

controls.name: Access control and validation procedures
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revi

controls.name: Maintenance records
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks).

controls.name: Workstation use
controls.description: Standard. Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or c

controls.name: Workstation security
controls.description: Standard. Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users.

controls.name: Device and media controls
controls.description: Standard. Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items with

controls.name: Disposal
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.

controls.name: Media re-use
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.

controls.name: Accountability
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore.

controls.name: Data backup and storage
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment.

controls.name: Access control
controls.description: Unique user identification, emergency access, automatic logoff, encryption/decryption.

controls.name: Unique user identification
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

controls.name: Emergency access procedure
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.

controls.name: Automatic logoff
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

controls.name: Encryption and decryption
controls.description: Encrypt and decrypt ePHI (addressable).

controls.name: Audit controls
controls.description: Record and examine activity in systems that contain or use ePHI.

controls.name: Integrity
controls.description: Protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.name: Mechanism to authenticate electronic protected health information
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that electronic protected health information has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.

controls.name: Person or entity authentication
controls.description: Verify that a person or entity seeking access is who they claim to be.

controls.name: Transmission security
controls.description: Guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over networks; integrity controls and encryption (e)(2)(ii).

controls.name: Integrity controls
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.

controls.name: Encryption
controls.description: Implementation specification (Addressable). Implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate.

controls.name: Business associate arrangements
controls.description: Contract requirements between covered entities and business associates.

controls.name: Business associate contract requirements
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). —(i) Business associate contracts. The contract must provide that the business associate will—

controls.name: Requirements for group health plans
controls.description: Standard. Except when the only electronic protected health information disclosed to a plan sponsor is disclosed pursuant to § 164.504(f)(1)(ii) or (iii), or as authorized under § 164.508, a group health plan must ensure that its p

controls.name: Group health plan document requirements
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). The plan documents of the group health plan must be amended to incorporate provisions to require the plan sponsor to—

controls.name: Documentation requirements
controls.description: Maintain written policies/procedures and retain documentation for six years.

controls.name: Policies and procedures
controls.description: Standard. Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart, taking into account those factors specified in § 164.306(b)

controls.name: Documentation
controls.description: Standard. (i) Maintain the policies and procedures implemented to comply with this subpart in written (which may be electronic) form; and

controls.name: Time limit
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Retain the documentation required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section for 6 years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.

controls.name: Availability
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which the documentation pertains.

controls.name: Updates
controls.description: Implementation specification (Required). Review documentation periodically, and update as needed, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of the electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Definitions (breach, unsecured PHI)
controls.description: Defines a breach and the four-factor risk assessment showing a low probability that PHI has been compromised.

controls.name: Notification to individuals
controls.description: Notify affected individuals without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 days after discovery.

controls.name: Notification to the media
controls.description: Notify prominent media outlets when a breach affects more than 500 residents of a State or jurisdiction.

controls.name: Notification to the Secretary (HHS)
controls.description: Notify HHS; breaches of 500+ individuals within 60 days, smaller breaches annually.

controls.name: Notification by a business associate
controls.description: Business associate must notify the covered entity of a breach without unreasonable delay.

controls.name: Law enforcement delay
controls.description: Delay notification when law enforcement states it would impede a criminal investigation.

controls.name: Administrative requirements and burden of proof
controls.description: The covered entity or business associate must be able to show that all notifications were made or that no breach occurred.

controls.name: Uses and disclosures of PHI
controls.description: General rules governing permitted uses and disclosures, including the minimum necessary standard.

controls.name: Uses and disclosures: organizational requirements
controls.description: Business associate contracts, hybrid entities and group health plan requirements.

controls.name: Uses and disclosures for treatment, payment or health care operations
controls.description: Permitted uses and disclosures of PHI for treatment, payment and health care operations.

controls.name: Uses and disclosures requiring an authorization
controls.description: A valid written authorization is required for uses and disclosures not otherwise permitted, e.g. marketing.

controls.name: Uses and disclosures requiring an opportunity to agree or object
controls.description: Facility directories and disclosures to family members or others involved in care.

controls.name: Uses and disclosures not requiring authorization or opportunity to agree
controls.description: Disclosures required by law, for public health, law enforcement, research and other listed purposes.

controls.name: Other requirements: de-identification and minimum necessary
controls.description: De-identification standards, limited data sets and the minimum necessary standard.

controls.name: Notice of privacy practices
controls.description: Provide individuals with a notice of the covered entity's privacy practices.

controls.name: Rights to request privacy protection
controls.description: Requests for restrictions and for confidential communications.

controls.name: Access of individuals to PHI
controls.description: Individuals' right to inspect and obtain a copy of their PHI.

controls.name: Amendment of PHI
controls.description: Individuals' right to have PHI amended.

controls.name: Accounting of disclosures
controls.description: Individuals' right to an accounting of disclosures of their PHI.

controls.name: Administrative requirements
controls.description: Privacy official, workforce training, safeguards, complaints, sanctions, mitigation and documentation.
